title: Holo/Gradient Mesh
content: Apply holographic aesthetic with gradient mesh feel. Complex multi-color gradients. Mesh gradient backgrounds. Rainbow shimmer effects. Metallic and iridescent surfaces. Glow and bloom effects. Prismatic color splits. Foil and chrome textures. Gradient borders. Animated color cycling. Glassmorphism combination.

variants.simple: Create holographic style with mesh gradients, rainbow effects, and futuristic glow.
variants.detailed: Apply holographic aesthetic with gradient mesh feel. Complex multi-color gradients. Mesh gradient backgrounds. Rainbow shimmer effects. Metallic and iridescent surfaces. Glow and bloom effects. Prismatic color splits. Foil and chrome textures. Gradient borders. Animated color cycling. Glassmorphism combination.
variants.advanced: Apply holographic aesthetic with mesh gradient patterns. Mesh gradients: multiple color stops positioned as radial gradients, blended together for organic flow. Background: conic-gradient with multiple color stops, animate hue-rotate for living color. Shimmer: linear-gradient overlay with transparency, animate background-position for sweep effect. Metallic: linear-gradient with multiple stops (light, mid, dark, light), creates chrome illusion. Iridescence: pseudo-element with mix-blend-mode: color-dodge, hue-shift on scroll/hover. Glow: multiple box-shadows with different colors, blur-lg for bloom effect. Prismatic: text or element with pseudo-elements offset in RGB colors, chromatic aberration effect. Foil: noisy gradient texture, animate subtly for holographic foil feel. Gradient borders: background gradient on parent, solid background on child with gap for border. Glass: backdrop-blur combined with gradient background for colorful glass. Text: gradient fill with animated movement, sparkle overlay. Buttons: gradient background, glow on hover, animated border. Cards: gradient border with solid fill, holographic shine on tilt (mouse position). Noise: SVG noise texture overlay at low opacity for texture. Implementation: CSS gradients, SVG filters for advanced effects. Performance: hardware-accelerated animations, limit simultaneous animations.
